comments.author: HalfPint
comments.body:
NPC Weapon Techs & Traps used & Misc. drops.

SWORD-- Sword techs require a sword equipped to be able to acquire.
Swedish Mercenary Lv10 LP (105) (Exchange 1)
-- Sweeping Slash R1) No Requirements
-- Lifting Slash R1(Y) (No Requirements)
-- Trick Sword R1*(Y) (SP R3, Feint R6, (Lifting Slash acquired)

AXE. >>>> Axe weapon equipped to be able to acquire Techs.
Viking Lv7, Life Points (70) (Exchange 1)
-- Bring Down R1(R) No Requirements.
-- Triple Swing R2(B) (SP R7, Quick R6, (Chain Swing acquired)
-- Drop Down R1(B) No Requirements
-- Trick Axe R1*(Y) (SP R3, Feint R4, (Drop Down acquired)
-- Big Drop Down R2(Y) (SP R9, Feint R8, (Drop Down acquired)

Norway Bandit Lv7, LP(75) (Exchange 2)
-- Bring Down R1(R) No Requirements.
-- Strike Down R2(R) (SP R5, Power R4, (Bring Down acquired))
-- Triple Swing R2(B) (SP R7, Quick R6, (Chain Swing acquired))
-- Trick Axe R1*(Y) (SP R3, Feint R4, (Drop Down acquired)

GUN >>> Gun Equipped to Acquire Techs.
Grave Robber Lvl9, LP(105) (Exchange 2) (Surgeon's secret elixir)
-- Charge Shot R1 (R) Nor Requirements
-- Trick Shot R1*(Y) (GF R3, Feint R8, (Sure Shot acquired))

TRAPS
Bee Call
-- Plunderer Lv8, LP(75) (Exchange 2)

SP = Swordplay, SM = Sword Mastery, GF = Gunfire,
Exchange = Random Spawn, (R) = Red, (B) = Blue, (Y) = Yellow
If I tech is not here please add, thank you.
